message.reasoning_content: We need to determine charges. Facts: The defendant 常2某 is a deputy director and researcher at Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Department Development Plan Division. He used his position to obtain bribes: received cash and a pearl necklace from people in exchange for helping them get national innovation fund projects, also got reimbursements via false invoices. Also participated in scheme to falsify project applications and divert funds, colluding with other officials. So crimes:受贿 (bribery). Also possibly滥用职权、挪用公款? He helped falsify projects and allowed funds to be taken, which is职务侵占? Actually taking public funds for personal use is embezzlement (挪用公款) or贪污? He accepted bribes, also participated in fraud of state funds: maybe “职务侵占” or “挪用公款”。But the main is受贿. The rule: If facts describe a person in managerial or official position receiving money or valuables in exchange for using职务便利, classify the crime simply as "受贿" unless source explicitly states otherwise. Here indeed he received money for using his position. So we output only 受贿. No need to add other crimes. According to correction rule, output plain offense names without 罪. So [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
